tldr: Mars in the 4th house: drive becomes personal through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
body:
With Mars in the 4th house, this part of you pushes through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations. Mars describes drive, anger, courage, desire, defense, and the will to act. In practice, this brings attention to the private base of your life, including the rooms, roots, memories, and relationships that shape where you feel held.

When this placement is supported, your inner life can feel more rooted and easier to live from. Mars can become courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters.

When it is strained, old patterns can run the room before you have had time to name them. The harder pattern can show up as reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear.
gift: courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters expressed through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
challenge: reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear around home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
